profile.headline: IT Development Manager
profile.summary:
A Software Engineer with experience in .NET programming, and web development.  Efficient in managing diverse workload and getting projects done.  Ability to work in a team and/or individually.  Capable of learning new software and willing to share knowledge with team members.

Specialties: •	C#
•	VB.NET
•	C, C++
•	ASP.NET
•	AJAX
•	Point of Sale (POS) App	
•	SQL Server 2000/2005
•	Visual Studio .NET
•	Team Foundation
•	Microsoft Source Safe	•	Object-Oriented Programming
•	Object-Oriented Analysis & Design
•	Microsoft Foundation Class (MFC)
•	Unified Model Language (UML)
•	Salesforce

positions.title: Intermediate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to enhance, develop, and modify web applications with a range of different technologies including C#, Classic ASP, NET Framework 2.0-4.0, and SQL Server 2008.

Modified Winforms application using C#, Visual Studio 2010, and SQL.  The application provided a way for user to add and/or update fees for a specific facility.

Modified and Enhanced Securus Change Control web application using Classic ASP and SQL Server 2005.  The internal application provided employees a way to schedule change control and keep track of changes made to applications, software and hardware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to enhance, develop, and modify web applications with a range of different technologies including C#, VB.NET, NET Framework 2.0-3.5, Reporting Services and SQL Server 2005.

Developed and modified Visitor Registration System (VRS) web application using SQL, VB.Net, C#, and ASP.NET.  The application provided a way for administrative personnel, security and managers to register visitors, contractors, employees, and others who may enter the building.

Developed and modified Material Estimating System (EMCBid) web application using C#, ASP.NET, Microsoft Reporting Services, and SQL Server 2005.  The application captured, analyze, price, and report the material estimating data to be meaningful for the preparation of the formal bid to the customer.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design, develop, modify, and implement software application.
•	Developed web applications using ASP.NET, and AJAX toolkit.
•	Developed .NET application in C#, and VB.NET.
•	Created Stored Procedures and Databases in SQL Server 2000/2005.
•	Worked with Business Analyst to resolve applications problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·	Developed C#.Net component that interfaced with a web reference.
·	Created Stored Procedures from Sql Server 2000 that interfaced with the C#.Net component.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
·	Worked with quality assurance, and customer support to resolve application problems.
·	Developed, tested code changes for fixes, identified and resolved complex problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
·	Prototyped, designed, implemented, tested, and deployed Graphical User Interface (GUI) for a Software Evaluation Station using Visual C++ on Windows NT/2000 to allow system to be more user friendly.
·	Gained detailed knowledge of MFC classes, C++, Object-Oriented Design and Programming to become proficient in Graphical User Interface (GUI) development.

·	Designed, and implemented a bootable VxWorks image on a Tornado environment 
·	Received a Spotlight on Excellence Award 2000 for learning the Defect Logger tool and training all team members on tool usage.
·	Converted FORTRAN into C to allow source code to become readable, maintainable code.
·	Developed and implemented an automation tool to help developers count the lines of C code.
·	Implemented Structured Query Language (SQL) commands to access and manipulate Sybase database system.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Mathematics with an emphasis in Computer Science
